fusions.name: Flashover
fusions.desc: Pounces up to 6 tiles onto an enemy for 16 damage and strips 10% of its armour for 5 seconds. It uses up every affliction you have on the target for 60% more damage each.

fusions.name: Flicked Embers
fusions.desc: Flicks 3 embers from your paws in a spread, each dealing 3 damage to the first enemy it meets with a 30% chance to set it [Burning] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Smouldering Hackles
fusions.desc: Raises your hackles for 8 seconds: 30% of the damage you take is dealt back to the attacker, who is set [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Hot Tin Roof
fusions.desc: You move 8% faster, and you have 10% fire resistance.
